prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I've spent weeks conducting a survey targeting speakers of different varieties of English, and the last two calls I had to make today were to a lawyer and a server. I had a great conversation with the server, who was very helpful, but I had so much trouble understanding what the lawyer was saying that I just gave up after about two minutes. Who speaks proper English?
A. The lawyer
B. The server
C. Cannot be determined
